title: Paramount seeks $1.88 billion bond from state AGs to cover costs of WBD merger delay
summary_full: Paramount agreed to delay its proposed acquisition of WBD to as late as June 2027 while the state AGs' case heads to trial.
summary_public: Paramount agreed to delay its proposed acquisition of WBD to as late as June 2027 while the state AGs' case heads to trial.
